title: Single-source MCP server definition (ADR-0017)
description: Lives only in the untracked local overlay. Holds server names, commands, args and NON-secret environment values. A credential is never written here: it is named under secrets with its source and read by global/mcp/mcp-launch.sh when the server starts. global/mcp/mcp_render.py enforces this schema itself (plus two credential-name checks a schema cannot express); this file documents it for editors.

active_set.description: Issue #219 (ADR-0041). When present, the servers above are the MCP active set: mhw install turns off every other MCP server through each agent harness's own switch (Codex enabled = false, Claude Code deniedMcpServers, Kiro disabled), reports the Claude desktop app's, and uninstall turns back on what it turned off. Absent, nothing is turned off. With it, a server's surfaces must include codex, claude-code and kiro (parity), or be left out.

connectors.description: claude.ai connector display name, as Claude Code lists it after the 'claude.ai ' prefix -> on (in the set) or off (denied in Claude Code as serverName 'claude.ai <Name>'). Connectors are account-level: no local file lists them, so only the ones named here are acted on.

command.description: The program the surface starts (local stdio servers only).

env.description: NON-secret values only. A name that looks like a credential (TOKEN, SECRET, PASSWORD, API_KEY, AUTH, ...) is refused unless listed in not_secret.

secrets.description: Environment variable NAME -> where its value comes from at launch. keychain:<service> is macOS only.

not_secret.description: env names or args flags that look like credentials but have been reviewed as not secret.
